title: app_icons: daily_limits gets the hourglass glyph in the shared family
objective: The daily-limits phone app ships a family launcher icon (charcoal #211D1B field, shared accent #B8862E) instead of the stock Flutter icon, with no change to any other app's icon.
acceptance_criteria: `generate --app daily_limits --android` writes assets/icon and the Android mipmaps for ~/src/daily-limits/app
The registry keeps one accent (#B8862E) and one field (style.BACKGROUND) for every app
The diff to python_pkg/app_icons is additive only, so every other app renders byte-identically
python_pkg/app_icons tests pass at 100% line and branch coverage; pre-commit is clean
out_of_scope: A per-app background or accent override (decided 2026-10-09: the generator's shared colours are right)
